items.name: accordion
items.description: A stack of disclosure rows whose panels ease open to their natural height and back to zero, the chevron rotating with the state.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.description: Tabs where the active pill slides between triggers as a shared element and the panel cross-fades with a small drift.

items.name: animated-tooltip
items.description: Overlapping avatar row where the tooltip leans with your cursor: its tilt and horizontal shift follow where you are over the avatar, so the card feels balanced on your fingertip.

items.name: announcement
items.description: Slim top banner that slides down on mount and, when dismissed, collapses its height and fades away.

items.name: aurora-background
items.description: Section wrapper bathed in three huge, heavily blurred lumen blobs that drift on very slow loops behind the content, finished with a faint grain and vignette so the glow reads quiet rather than loud.

items.name: avatar
items.description: Identity disc with a graceful fallback: if the image errors, initials crossfade in so the swap never flashes.

items.name: badge
items.description: Status chip: a quiet pill whose optional dot can breathe a slow expanding ring to mark live state.

items.name: beam-grid
items.description: A faint line grid where occasional beams of lumen travel along random grid lines — horizontal beams slide right, vertical beams fall — on long, staggered loops.

items.name: border-beam
items.description: Wraps its child with a luminous beam endlessly traveling around the border: a rotating conic gradient (bright head, transparent tail) is masked down to the border ring via the padding-box/border-box mask composite trick, so only the ring ever lights up.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.description: Path trail where hovering a link slides a soft lumen underline in from the left.

items.name: carousel
items.description: Drag-to-snap carousel: the track follows your pointer with elastic edges and settles on the nearest slide when released.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Accessible checkbox: checking fills the box with the lumen, pops it with a tiny scale breath, and draws the check stroke in along its path; the `indeterminate` state shows a dash instead.

items.name: cursor-trail
items.description: A container whose pointer movement leaves a trail of small image cards: every `threshold` px of travel a card pops in at the cursor with a spring and a slight deterministic rotation, then fades and shrinks away ~700ms later.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Modal dialog: the page dims behind a blurred overlay while the panel breathes in from 96% scale with a slight upward drift.

items.name: dock
items.description: A bottom dock whose items swell as the cursor nears them — each item's size is a transform of the cursor's distance from its center.

items.name: drawer
items.description: Side panel: it glides in from its edge over a blurred overlay and can be dragged back out — release past 30% of its size (or with a flick) and it dismisses.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: Anchored action menu: it drifts open with a slight scale while items cascade in at 12ms intervals, flipping above the trigger when the viewport runs out.

items.name: elastic-stack
items.description: A fanned deck where only the top card is draggable: pull it sideways against elastic constraints — release beyond `threshold` and it flings off with your velocity, then glides back in at the rear while the rest shuffle one step forward; release short of it and it snaps home.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.description: Drop zone whose dashed border brightens into a soft lumen glow while a file hovers over it, the upload glyph nudging upward in anticipation.

items.name: flip-text
items.description: Cycles words by flipping them around the X axis: the current word's characters tip away (rotateX → -90°) while the next word's tip in (90° → 0°) under shared perspective, each character 18ms behind the last, and the container's width glides between word widths.

items.name: folder
items.description: An interactive folder drawn from CSS shapes: hovering tilts the front lid open on its bottom hinge while up to three items rise out of the slot with a stagger and a slight fan; clicking toggles it held open (button semantics with aria-expanded).

items.name: glitch-text
items.description: Text that rests perfectly clean, then glitches for ~350ms when hovered (or on a loop): two aria-hidden copies tinted lumen and dusk flicker in with small horizontal offsets and sliced clip-paths, then everything settles.

items.name: gradient-text
items.description: Inline text painted by a slow lumen gradient that sweeps left to right on a seamless loop — accent into foreground and back.

items.name: hover-link
items.description: An anchor with an animated lumen underline.

items.name: input
items.description: Floating-label text input: the label sits where a placeholder would, then rises and shrinks once the field is focused or filled, while a 1px accent underline draws in from the left.

items.name: kbd
items.description: A keyboard key cap with a raised bottom edge.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.description: Wrap anything to make it magnetic: while the cursor is within `radius` px of the zone's center the child leans toward it, then snaps back home on leave.

items.name: marquee
items.description: A seamless infinite belt of content: children are duplicated (the copy is `aria-hidden`) and the track translates exactly one copy's width per loop, so the seam never shows.

items.name: morph-text
items.description: Cycles words by dissolving: the outgoing word blurs and fades while the incoming one sharpens out of the same blur with a subtle tracking widen, the two overlapping for ~40% of the transition.

items.name: number-ticker
items.description: A number that counts up on a spring once it scrolls into view, settling on `value`.

items.name: otp-input
items.description: One-time-code entry: one cell per digit, each popping on a snappy spring as it fills while the accent ring tracks the active cell.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Page switcher: the active pill glides between numbers as a shared element on `springs.snap`, and the prev/next arrows nudge outward on hover.

items.name: popover
items.description: Anchored floating panel: opens from its trigger with a drift-and-scale breath out of the anchor side, flipping to the opposite side when the viewport is too tight.

items.name: progress
items.description: Progress bar: the determinate fill glides to each new value on a weighty spring; `indeterminate` sends a soft lumen segment traveling the track on a slow loop (a static mid-fill under reduced motion).

items.name: radio-group
items.description: Radio group: selecting an item pops the inner dot in on a snappy spring while a soft lumen ring expands outward once and fades.

items.name: rating
items.description: Star rating with slider semantics: hovering previews the fill sweeping up to the pointer with a tiny per-star stagger, clicking commits with a pop on the chosen star, and arrow keys adjust the value in steps (halves with `allowHalf`).

items.name: reveal-list
items.description: Editorial list of large rows: hovering a row summons a floating preview image that trails the cursor on a lagging spring and crossfades as you move between rows, while the other rows dim back.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.description: A fixed 2px accent bar that fills as the page scrolls, smoothed by a spring so the fill glides rather than jitters.

items.name: segmented-control
items.description: Pill segment switcher: the raised pill glides between segments as a shared element on a snappy spring.

items.name: select
items.description: Single-select listbox: the menu drifts open with a slight scale while options cascade in at 15ms intervals; the chosen option carries a check glyph.

items.name: separator
items.description: A quiet rule that fades to transparent at both ends, so it never cuts a hard edge into the layout.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder: a soft surface block with a slow light sweep gliding across on a 1.8s loop.

items.name: slider
items.description: Range slider: the accent-filled track follows a thumb that swells on a snappy spring while dragged, with an optional value bubble floating above it.

items.name: spotlight
items.description: Full-section pointer spotlight: a soft circle of lumen trails the cursor on a spring, fading in on entry and out on exit, like a hand-held light passing over the content.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.description: A surface card whose border lights up and a soft radial lumen glow trails the cursor; the glow fades in on enter and out on leave.

items.name: stepper
items.description: Step indicator whose connector lines fill with the lumen as steps complete, numbers crossfading into a drawn-in check.

items.name: switch
items.description: Accessible toggle: the knob slides across the track on a snappy spring (layout animation) while the track crossfades to the accent.

items.name: table
items.description: Quiet data table: hairline borders, a surface-toned header, and rows that brighten gently under the pointer.

items.name: text-reveal
items.description: Scroll-linked paragraph reveal: as the text crosses a band of the viewport, each word brightens from faint to full foreground and sheds a slight blur, so the sentence appears to come into focus as you read.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Floating-label textarea: the label rests where a placeholder would, then rises and shrinks once the field is focused or filled while a 1px accent underline draws in from the left.

items.name: tilt-card
items.description: A card that tilts in 3D toward the cursor and drifts flat again on leave.

items.name: timeline
items.description: Vertical event list: the spine draws itself downward as the list scrolls into view, while each node pops and its content drifts in the first time it enters the viewport.

items.name: toast
items.description: Fire a toast from anywhere — components, event handlers, async code.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: Pressed-button group: in single mode a raised backplate glides between pressed items as a shared element on `springs.snap`; in multiple mode each item simply latches.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Anchored tooltip that waits `delay` ms, then drifts in with a slight rise toward its anchor.

items.name: typewriter
items.description: Types each word character by character beside a blinking caret, holds, deletes, and moves to the next.

items.name: auth-form
items.description: Centered auth card resting on a faint lumen glow.

items.name: changelog
items.description: Release notes with a hairline spine down the left edge.

items.name: faq
items.description: Two-column FAQ: the heading stays pinned on the left while disclosures open on the right, each answer unfolding to its natural height as the chevron turns over.

items.name: features
items.description: Asymmetric bento grid: one large anchor card and a constellation of small ones.

items.name: footer
items.description: Quiet closing footer: four link columns beside the brand, links resting at the faintest type tone and brightening on hover, with an optional inline newsletter form and a small-print baseline.

items.name: logo-strip
items.description: A "trusted by" belt of fictional text wordmarks.

items.name: navbar
items.description: Sticky top navigation that rides transparent over the hero, then settles onto a blurred overlay with a hairline border once you scroll past the threshold.

items.name: pricing
items.description: Three-tier pricing with a segmented billing toggle: a single pill slides between monthly and yearly while every price crossfades to its new value.

items.name: stats
items.description: A horizontal band of large counting stats.

items.name: testimonials
items.description: Two rows of quote cards drift past each other in opposite directions on a seamless loop, pausing under the cursor with soft fades at either edge.

items.name: chat-widget
items.description: Floating chat launcher (bottom-right, with a slow lumen pulse) that springs open into a panel from its own corner.

items.name: command-menu
items.description: Owns the open state of a `CommandMenu` and binds the global ⌘K / Ctrl-K toggle.

items.name: selection-toolbar
items.description: Wraps content and floats a pill toolbar above any text the user selects inside it — the pill scales in with one soft drift breath, anchored to the selection rect.

items.name: apple
items.description: Apple — the bitten-apple mark with leaf.

items.name: discord
items.description: Discord — the rounded game-controller / face mark.

items.name: facebook
items.description: Facebook — the lowercase "f" inside the rounded badge.

items.name: git
items.description: Git — the rotated-square logo with the three-node branch.

items.name: google
items.description: Google — the "G" mark (monochrome; the brand's four colors theme away).

items.name: instagram
items.description: Instagram — rounded-square camera with lens and corner dot.

items.name: javascript
items.description: JavaScript — "JS" knocked out of a square.

items.name: linkedin
items.description: LinkedIn — rounded square with the "in" wordmark.

items.name: nextjs
items.description: Next.js — the circle with the diagonal "N" stroke.

items.name: nodejs
items.description: Node.js — the hexagon with the cut "N".

items.name: notion
items.description: Notion — the "N" page mark inside its rounded frame.

items.name: npm
items.description: npm — the square with the "npm" knockout.

items.name: python
items.description: Python — the two interlocking snakes mark.

items.name: react
items.description: React — the atom: a nucleus dot orbited by three ellipses.

items.name: slack
items.description: Slack — the four interlocking rounded bars (hashtag pinwheel).

items.name: tailwind
items.description: Tailwind CSS — the twin overlapping waves.

items.name: twitch
items.description: Twitch — the angled-corner chat glyph with two viewer bars.

items.name: typescript
items.description: TypeScript — "TS" knocked out of a rounded square.
